Messages.Body: Without even going into your library choices, you need to address the glaring question - why so many vampires in the crypt? If your plan for survival is villein+golconda on your own vampires, that's not much of a plan...

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body:
Wow, less masters would help, add entrancement, concordance, and stealth. The master package lets you not die, you need pressure. Other ideas: condemnation mute, concordance, unleash hells fury, maybe switch some majesty to force of personality.

Most importantly, less vamps.
